node.title: Re^3: handling WWW::Mechanize Error GETing
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Hi,

Using if($@) is unreliable,

The correct pattern is $temp = eval { $mech->get($imgsrc) }; if( not $temp ){ ... }

But we're using mech so we dont need to store the response in $temp

So even better eval { $mech->get( $imgsrc ); }; if( not $mech->res->is_success ){ ... }

Or even better if( not eval { $mech->get( $imgsrc ); 1 } ){ ... }

Or simply the generic version , it doesn't rely on $@ eval { $mech->get( $imgsrc ); 1 } or do { ... };

For explanation why using if($@) is unreliable see [metamod://Devel::EvalError] -- Reliably detect if and why eval() failed
